node.label: aspartylglucosaminuria
node.definition: Aspartylglycosaminuria (AGU) is an autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disease belonging to the oligosaccharidosis group (also called glycoproteinosis).

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
